lead: Cristiano Ronaldo is a Portuguese association football player, born on 5 February 1985 in Funchal.
As of 2026, he is 41 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has represented Al-Nassr and has 3 credited works on public record.

sections.heading: Cristiano Ronaldo — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Cristiano Ronaldo was born on 5 February 1985 in Funchal, and holds Portuguese nationality. He was given the name Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro at birth and is publicly known as Cristiano Ronaldo.
Public records name his father, José Dinis Aveiro and his mother, Maria Dolores dos Santos Aveiro. He is a sibling of Elma dos Santos Aveiro, Hugo Aveiro and Kátia Aveiro.
He is recorded as speaking Portuguese, Spanish and English.

sections.heading: Cristiano Ronaldo — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists association football player as his main occupation.
On the team sheet, Cristiano has been associated with Al-Nassr (from 2023). He plays as a wing half.
He has taken part in 2004 Summer Olympics, 2014 FIFA World Cup, 2010 FIFA World Cup, 2006 FIFA World Cup and UEFA Euro 2012.
